title: Hoshino Ichika — Unformed Feelings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't believe it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Pardon me♪
Oh, there they are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi! Hona!
Wanna have lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh...
Umm... I...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm? No yakisoba bun, Ichika?
Have you not had a chance to buy any yet?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You weren't able to buy lunch?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was late getting to the store because our last class ended up going over a bit...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I didn't realize they could run out...
I'm glad I brought a lunch today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
I just came up with a great idea♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The three of us all brought lunches today, right, Hona, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, why don't we make Ichi a one-of-a-kind lunch platter by sharing some of our food with her?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, why not? You should be able to have plenty if all three of us pitch in. It'll be a lot better than splitting one lunch between two people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only that, you'll get to have a wider variety.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: N-No, I couldn't...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You can't turn us down, Ichi!
Anyway, let's head down to the courtyard!
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you sure about this? You're really going to share your lunches with me...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, of course♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We need to help each other out whenever one of us is in need.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's start putting together Ichi's one-of-a-kind Leo/need lunch platter!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Starting with me! I have... Ta-daa!
Mini rice balls!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, they have smiley faces made of seaweed on them. That's really cute.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right? Oh, you'll have to make do with using the lid to my container as your plate.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, here's a smiling rice ball...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, I'll give you one of my mini Salisbury steaks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll add a bit of color and balance out the nutrients by throwing in some of my marinated vegetable salad.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wow...
It already feels like a real lunch.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But two side dishes seems like not very much. Why don't I also give you one of my omelets...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I also have omelets, so you can have one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've got some too. Here, Ichi, have one!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Getting to try all of your families' omelets sort of makes this a special occasion.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You can tell us how they compare.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! You can try to guess who made which omelets, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! That sounds really hard.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Just give it a try♪
Now, close your eyes for me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, let me know when everything's ready...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I should turn the lid around a different way. Otherwise, she'll know immediately...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. That should be enough. Ichika, you can open your eyes now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's get our blind omelet quiz underway! Start with whichever one you like, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Again, thank you all for being so kind. I think I'll start with this one on the right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mmm... The broth just gushed right out... This feels like a Hinomori omelet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? Yeah, that's right...
I'm impressed, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You did share some with me when we swapped dishes before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Next, I'll try the one in the middle.
Oh, it's pretty sweet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And the last one... Mmm... I'm sensing a hint of soy sauce.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, who made which...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... The sweet one was yours, Saki, and the one on the left was Honami's... I think?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right! We have a winner!
That's a clean sweep, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Despite not sounding so confident, you got them all right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yours and Saki's were actually pretty easy, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I doubt the three of you would have any trouble guessing either since we do share food all the time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know. We wouldn't have a hard time, but it might be fun to have Miku and the others try this game.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that would be fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You could include some of the omelets from your house when we do, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Do you think they'll be able to figure it out?
